name: TRA-BLU!
source:
After the platonic love of the student days passed, Asato and Akane went to Tokyo to realize their common dream. 
They started living under the same roof, things are hectic but at the same time their trust and love for each other deepens.
Under that condition Kyousuke, the childhood friend of Ayane, suddenly intruded upon their peaceful lives.
Asato can't help but feel jealous remembering the close relationship of those two during the old times.
One day while Asato was busy with work, Kyousuke suddenly confessed to Akane.
The unwavering heart of Akane started to falter.
"Even if we're seperated we'll still love each other." Asato. Kyousuke, thats always besides her.
There's still two weeks left of Kyousuke's promise.

Will Asato and Akane pass the storm...? Or...?
translation:
学生时代柏拉图式的恋爱结束后，朝人和茜为了实现共同梦想前往东京。
两人开始在同一屋檐下生活。日子虽然忙乱，彼此的信任与爱情却也不断加深。
就在此时，绫音的青梅竹马恭介突然闯入了两人的平静生活。
朝人回想起二人过去的亲密关系，心中不由自主地产生嫉妒。
一天，趁朝人忙于工作，恭介突然向茜表白。
茜原本坚定不移的心开始动摇。
“即使分开，我们也依然相爱。”这是朝人。始终陪在身旁的则是恭介。
距离恭介约定的期限还剩两周。

朝人与茜能否渡过这场风暴…？还是说…？
